project: Autonomous Multi-Agent EV Battery Life & Range Predictor
prediction_horizon_semantics: Positional shift by 1 observed cycle record. The target is the SOH of the next observed record, not necessarily the next physical cycle. For B5, observed transitions include 100->151 (difference 51) and 200->401 (difference 201); the label filter also creates 39->41 (difference 2) because cycle_id=40 has a null SOH label.

model_readiness.benchmark_warning: The persistence baseline outperforms every reported learned SOH model. Do not describe any model as production-ready.

lfp_lgbm.note: Higher MAE than persistence. The test subset contains only adjacent observed cycle-ID pairs (0 gap-crossing pairs).

nmc_bilstm.note: Higher MAE than persistence on the identical 83-row subset. Not served by Member2Predictor.

nmc_rul_lgbm.note: All 97 test targets are post-EOL (RUL=0); no pre-EOL forecasting capability is established.

nmc_rul_test.label: NMC RUL Test
nmc_rul_test.evaluation_note: 100% of test cycles occur post-80% EOL (ground truth RUL=0.0). Test set has zero target variance. MAE=0.0588 reflects baseline post-EOL behavior, not validated degradation forecasting.

nmc_identical_sequence_comparison_n83.evaluation_protocol: Exact identical 83 test sequence cycles (chronological holdout)
nmc_identical_sequence_comparison_n83.note: BiLSTM outperforms LightGBM on identical inputs due to continuous representation, but both underperform persistence due to chronological domain shift.

caveats: 250 observed cycle IDs in cell B5 form three contiguous blocks: 1-100, 151-200 and 401-500. IDs 101-150 (50 IDs) and 201-400 (200 IDs) are absent, i.e. 250 missing IDs between the observed minimum and maximum.
cycle_id=40 has a null SOH label (625 rows). The pipeline drops it, leaving 249 labelled cycles and 248 model-ready input->target pairs; this creates a 39->41 gap-crossing pair.
The two raw structural transitions 100->151 (difference 51) and 200->401 (difference 201) survive the filters. Targets are the next observed record, not necessarily the next physical cycle.
SOH labels CONDITIONAL (documented charge-balance discrepancy; 36.3% SOH transitions increase)
Learned SOH model underperforms persistence baseline: test MAE 0.9256 vs 0.1313 (n=51, adjacent observed pairs only)

Na-ion.reason: 100 cycles across 4 cells (25 cycles each). SOH ranges: Cell 64 (78.63%-79.22%), Cell 63 (88.60%-89.90%), Cell 62 (87.58%-88.55%), Cell 61 (90.35%-91.00%). Minimal intra-cell fade (delta <= 1.3%). Excluded from model training.
